thread:
sam: Heads-up: I opened a docs PR to unify rate-limit examples across SDKs and to add a minimal metering CSV for the quotas page. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4712. The PR includes a small Grafana panel JSON we can commit to the repo so linkchecker doesn't break.

leah: Nice — can you paste the CSV header here so I can validate against ingestion expectations? We need explicit `billing_event_id` and `timestamp_iso` columns. Also flagging that our docs previously used `tokens` vs `tokens_consumed` inconsistently.

sam: CSV header in the PR:```csv
timestamp_iso,billing_event_id,account_id,plan,tokens_consumed,route,status_code
```
Sample row: `2026-05-04T18:22:00Z,evt_f0e1d2,acct_004,pro,85,/v1/chat,200`

matt: Good catch on the tokens column mismatch. Please update the few examples that used `tokens` to `tokens_consumed` so our ingestion docs are consistent. Also request: add a 3-line note about timezone normalization (we only accept UTC) and one sentence about what to do when logs show duplicate event ids.

sam: Done — added a short troubleshooting note.

leah: For SDK snippets: can we include a tiny Go example? Support sometimes needs that. Show how to read `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers. Also mention `Retry-After` handling on 429.

sam: Added Python, Node, and a 6-line Go snippet. Paste Go snippet here for quick sanity check:
```go
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
fmt.Println(res.StatusCode)
fmt.Println(res.Header.Get("X-RateLimit-Remaining"))
```

matt: Fine. On the panel JSON: please ensure the plan order in the grouping is `free,pro,enterprise` — the stacked colors narrative mentions that order. Also add an annotation for burst-credit usage so readers can see when credits were applied.

sam: I added an annotations series called `burst_credits_applied` and a computed series `net_tokens = tokens_consumed - burst_credits_applied`. The panel JSON is stored at `docs/assets/panels/ratelimits-metering.json` in the PR.

infra-bot: Auto note: panel JSON validated against schema v1.2 (ok).

leah: One more doc nit: in `docs/pricing/tiers.md` we say "per-minute allowance" but our panels are hourly aggregates. Add a caution note so readers don't conflate the two.

sam: Added a caution in that file and linked to the quota enforcement section. Also updated a broken link that referenced the old Grafana URL (replaced with the repo asset path).

docs-ci-bot: CI: markdown linter passed, linkcheck passed, panel validation ok.

matt: Reviewed; left one comment about wording in the burst paragraph (suggest adding a sentence that gross vs net is important for billing reconciliation).

sam: Addressed the wording and pushed a small commit.

leah: Approved from docs side. Matt please give one last look at the panel colors and I'll merge.

matt: LGTM, merging after green.

sam: Thanks team! I'll add a changelog line: "docs: unify rate limit headers, add metering CSV example, commit panel asset and explain burst credits"

(END)
